title: New Orleans cornetists: Perez, Oliver, Keppard
summary: Pope remembers Manuel Perez and Joe Oliver visiting Mobile but not Keppard or Bolden.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: There were a couple of other famous New Orleans carnet players. One was Buddy Bold.

Did you ever hear him? I don't remember him, but I do remember Emmanuel Teres. Oh, yes. Do you remember him? Yes, I met him. I knew him. He died too. I didn't hear him play. Yeah, right. He always compared me with Perry. He used to come over here. Yeah, he did. I used to show off a little bit, you know, when he'd be in town, you know, I'd make some passengers there. And he'd say, you know, those fellas there, they can't do that, you know, like you like it.
Did you ever hear Joe Oliver? They called him King Oliver later?

Joe Oliver? Yes, I remember him in the early days. I think he used to play Yanmobili. He used to come over here and play for the next school. That's been quite a while now. Oh, yes, a long time. Yeah, I'm going way back. I remember quite a few out of the audience, but I just can't recall them now because I'm not prepared.
Did you ever hear Freddie Caput? No, I haven't. No, I haven't. From New Orleans. No, I haven't.
